exposure: History of preeclampsia (in a previous pregnancy)
Timing of preeclampsia onset in the primary pregnancy (early vs late)
Changes in mean arterial pressure (MAP) in early second trimester of subsequent pregnancy
outcome: Recurrence of preeclampsia in subsequent pregnancies
cohort: Singleton pregnant women who delivered at a single hospital between 2017 and 2021, experienced first-episode hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP), and subsequently had another pregnancy and delivery at the same hospital before 2023.
finding: Approximately 20% of patients with initial preeclampsia experienced recurrence, with early onset preeclampsia in the primary pregnancy and elevations in mean arterial pressure (MAP) during the early second trimester being important predictive factors for recurrence.
